newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila bourse stops RFC stock price rise.
newsitem.headline: Manila bourse stops RFC stock price rise.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange (PSE) on Tuesday halted the price rise of investment holding firm RFC Inc when it reached nine pesos, up three pesos, or 50 percent higher, from the previous day's close of six pesos.
The PSE's surveillance department said it has asked the company to explain the surge in its shares within the day.
The bourse automatically freezes the price of an issue if it climbs by 50 percent or near that level in a single trading day.
The surveillance department said it would suspend trading in RFC shares on Wednesday if the company failed to respond to the bourse's inquiry on Tuesday.
By mid-session, a total of 16,000 RFC Inc shares were traded.

Cilette Liboro, research head at Citisecurities Inc, said the market may be reacting to RFC's recent disclosure that it has purchased a 30 percent stake in Unitrust Development Bank, a small private bank in the Philippines, for 45 million pesos.
Grogram Ltd, a unit of MBf Holdings Berhad has a controlling stake in RFC.
